aiOverview.content: By December 2026, the U.S. Selective Service System will implement automatic draft registration for eligible men aged 18 to 26, using federal data sources to replace manual sign-ups. This change (detailed at Return to the Draft : Selective Service System) does not indicate an active draft or wartime conscription, which hasn't occurred since 1973.Key Aspects of the 2026 Automatic Registration:Automatic Process: The Selective Service System will register men automatically via databases, removing the requirement for self-registration.Target Population: Almost all male U.S. citizens and immigrants (including undocumented) aged 18–25 are required to be in the system.Purpose: The update aims to improve efficiency, reduce reliance on advertising, and update the database for potential national mobilization emergencies.Draft Status: There is currently no active military draft, and this, say sources, does not mean one is imminent.Draft Procedures & EligibilityIf a draft were ever authorized by Congress and the President:Order of Call: A lottery would be held. Those whose 20th birthday falls in the year of the draft would be called first, followed by ages 21–25, then 19, then 18.Exemptions: Men with disabilities or those on active duty are exempt; temporary deferments may be available for college students.Women: Women are not currently included in the draft, though they can volunteer.For more information on the upcoming changes, you can visit the Selective Service System website. By December 2026, the U.S. Selective Service System will implement automatic draft registration for eligible men aged 18 to 26, using federal data sources to replace manual sign-ups. This change (detailed at Return to the Draft : Selective Service System) does not indicate an active draft or wartime conscription, which hasn't occurred since 1973. Return to the Draft : Selective Service System Key Aspects of the 2026 Automatic Registration: Automatic Process: The Selective Service System will register men automatically via databases, removing the requirement for self-registration. Selective Service System Target Population: Almost all male U.S. citizens and immigrants (including undocumented) aged 18–25 are required to be in the system. Purpose: The update aims to improve efficiency, reduce reliance on advertising, and update the database for potential national mobilization emergencies. Draft Status: There is currently no active military draft, and this, say sources, does not mean one is imminent. Draft Procedures & EligibilityIf a draft were ever authorized by Congress and the President: Order of Call: A lottery would be held. Those whose 20th birthday falls in the year of the draft would be called first, followed by ages 21–25, then 19, then 18. Exemptions: Men with disabilities or those on active duty are exempt; temporary deferments may be available for college students. Women: Women are not currently included in the draft, though they can volunteer. For more information on the upcoming changes, you can visit the Selective Service System website.
